findings.why: Natural gas is roughly 85-95% methane. Ethane, propane and butane are only minor components, so (a) Methane is the principal constituent.

The Bawi system was officially ended in 1927, when the Assam government replaced the term 'bawi' with 'chhungte'/'awmpui'. Note the booklet prints the 1927 option with a duplicate '(b)' label, which is probably why the wrong box was shaded.
